html.h1: Welcome to the Corelight App for Splunk!
html.p: This setup page is designed to configure the app for correct display and optimized queries of your Corelight and open source Zeek data. Please ensure the correct indexes and products are selected on the configuration page.

blockquote.p: You can also review and edit these settings at any time by navigating to Administration > Configuration from the navigation bar: Corelight App Configuration
Please select the correct index names for your Corelight and/or Zeek data. Multiple indexes are supported. The default is the standard “corelight” index.

Please select whether you are using Corelight, open source Zeek, or both for your data sources. This will customize the field mappings and searches to match the appropriate logs. The default is Corelight only.

This app defaults to logging to the system log. You can customize the severity level with the dropdown, though this is not necessary as the defaults are preset for normal operations.
You can review and edit the log settings at any time from the following link: Logging Configuration
